name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (Tribal)
benefit: - **Financial Assistance for Modernization:** The scheme provides financial help for the modernization of Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs). - **Support for Basic Facility Creation:** Assistance is offered for the creation of essential and modern facilities within these market committees.
_eligibility_text: - Co-operative Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMC) shall be eligible under this scheme. - The applicant APMC must be located in designated tribal areas within Gujarat.
